_doc: Lookout Mountain Lariat V3 for tools/ship_track.sh (V3-PLAN P1; ledger 0048). The workshop lives OUTSIDE airoso (the sync rails require it). The draft order is plan P2 step 1 with the paint centreline wired in: gps (the OSM line; the paint line it overwrites is kept as data/centerline.previous.geojson first) -> paint_centreline (data/centerline.geojson becomes the paint line again) -> remap_config (--write: every vertex index and station in the config follows the line, by station matching) -> verify_centreline_paint (hard) -> route_oneway_check (hard) -> elev (heightfield: the 3DEP samples) -> road_profile (the profile smoothed by station, the declared lid held straight, capture.bridges written) -> project -> widths (the mountain OSM table) -> measured_widths (aerial > published > OSM, local frame) -> crossfall (footprint, estimated) -> verify_crossfall (roll rate, hard), so no OSM geometry ever reaches elevation or projection. The prep, exporter and spawn builder run from airoso's scripts/ac (never engine-july: that is San Diego's alone). Today the chain stops at 'no blend yet': there is no loop.blend and its builder, underlay (scripts/blender/underlay.py, P2 step 3), is not written.
_owed: Listed here as the plan's chain, not yet adapted for the Lariat (each still runs San Diego's shape and would fail or mis-build if reached; the chain cannot reach them before underlay exists): the race steps (race_bands / race_author / race_verify / race_scenery_gate / race_gates: SD's hard-coded STREETS become a config race block, P1 'race tools come from Lake Murray'); treefx (make_treefx reads zones, species and ground tiles from config); the P3 authoring steps (seat_terrain with station matching, cut/fill, edges, signs, lamps, buildings) are not listed at all yet.
